data.summary: The CR‑002 Random‑forest PD challenger was evaluated as an independent benchmark against the champion model. Key discrimination metrics include Gini — train {{m:run_098fd6:gini.train}}, Gini — test {{m:run_098fd6:gini.test}}, Gini — out‑of‑time {{m:run_098fd6:gini.oot}}, KS — out‑of‑time {{m:run_098fd6:ks.oot}}, and AUC — hold‑out {{m:run_098fd6:auc.holdout}}. Calibration is reflected by the Brier score — hold‑out {{m:run_098fd6:brier.holdout}} and Predicted × observed — hold‑out {{m:run_098fd6:calibration_ratio.holdout}}, while the observed outcome rate — hold‑out is {{m:run_098fd6:bad_rate.holdout}} and the approval rate at coded cutoff is {{m:run_098fd6:approval_rate.holdout}}. The validation identified {{m:run_098fd6:findings.high}} high‑severity finding, {{m:run_098fd6:findings.medium}} medium‑severity findings, for a total of {{m:run_098fd6:findings.total}} findings, with top issues including challenger training on the same rows, approval‑rate disparity by age band, direct use of age and personal status/sex, and hard‑coded shared‑drive paths. Overall rating: Requires remediation before continued use
